transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for making time for this verification meeting. As you know, we have a graduating senior whose preliminary transcript audit has three unresolved items — the capstone course, attendance recovery, and transfer or dual-enrollment credit. The district requires me to verify each of these items with the responsible staff members before I can certify graduation eligibility, and our certification deadline is this Friday at 4:00 p.m. I'd like to go through each item one at a time. For each, I'll need the exact finding and where the supporting record is held. Once I've recorded all three verified findings, I can proceed with certification — the actual upload of supporting records will be a follow-up task. Let's start with whoever is responsible for the capstone course record. Could you please share your finding?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Good morning, Ms. Brooks. I'm responsible for the capstone course record. I reviewed the student's capstone portfolio against the district rubric and recorded a passing result worth exactly 1 credit. The supporting record — the signed rubric — is held in my department file. Let me go ahead and formally reveal that finding for the record.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Good morning, Ms. Brooks. I'm responsible for the attendance recovery record. I can confirm that the student completed all of the district's required attendance-recovery sessions, so the attendance audit status must be recorded as exactly 'complete.' The supporting record — the completion sheet — is held in my office, though it has not yet been attached to the audit record. I'll formally reveal that finding now.
